site.title: NewTabLinks
site.motto: Your bookmarks, links, history & most visited on the new tab screen.
site.motto2: Finally useful use of new tab page
site.tagline: Your links, on every new tab, on every machine.

home.heading: A new tab that finally does something useful
home.leadParagraph: NewTabGroupedLinks replaces the empty new tab page with the links you actually open, arranged into groups of your own, alongside your history, your most-opened links and other configurable widgets and mini-apps.

features.groupsText: Columns you lay out yourself — groups holding links, and subgroups of links within them where you want them.
features.subgroupsText: Open every link in a subgroup one by one, all at once, or all at once gathered into a tab group with a name and a colour of your choosing.
workspacesText: One user can have several workspaces, each with its own groups of links.
The same goes for profiles — switch profile and you have another space for another set of workspaces and their link groups.
features.syncText: However many devices you have, as long as they are online your profiles, workspaces, groups and links stay in step.

download.heading: Download
download.leadParagraph: Install the extension from the Chrome Web Store, or download the packaged extension and load it yourself.
download.webStoreText: The recommended way to install. Updates arrive automatically.
download.webStoreUnavailable: The store listing is not published yet.
download.crxText: Hosted here. Load it through chrome://extensions with Developer Mode enabled.
download.crxUnavailable: The packaged download is not available yet.

register.heading: Create an ordinary account
register.usernameHint: 3 to 60 characters, allowed are: letters, digits, dot (.), underscore (_) and hyphen (-).
register.usernameChecking: Checking whether that username is free…
register.emailHint: The activation link is sent here.
register.displayNameHint: How you are addressed in the interface.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long passphrase is best.
register.passwordConfirmationHint: Type the same password again. You cannot see what you typed, so this is what catches a slip.
register.emailNotDelivered: The message could not be sent just now — our mail service did not accept it. Give it a few minutes, then ask for a new activation link below.
register.resendHint: Email can take a minute or two. If nothing turns up, ask for another activation link — it goes to the address you just entered.
register.googleAlternative: Or create your account with Google and skip having a password altogether.

login.heading: Log in
login.leadParagraph: Sign in to manage your account and the browsers connected to it.
login.googleHint: Signing in with Google creates the account the first time you use it.

activate.heading: Account activation
activate.success: Your account is active. You can log in now.
activate.missingToken: This activation link carries no token. Open the link from your email exactly as it was sent.

passwordReset.requestLead: Enter the address your account uses and we will send a reset link.
passwordReset.confirmLead: This signs every device out, so you will need to sign in again everywhere.
passwordReset.confirmSuccess: Your password is set. You can log in now.

authCallback.heading: Finishing sign-in
authCallback.missingCode: This page was opened without a sign-in code. Start again from the login page.

devices.heading: My devices
devices.leadParagraph: Every browser your account has been used from. This is a history, not a list of live sessions: a browser stays listed after it is signed out.
devices.emptyState: No browser has used this account yet.
devices.connectLead: Generate a code and type it into the extension to sign it in. This is also how an account created with Google connects the extension, since such an account has no password.
devices.connectCodeHint: Punctuation and letter case are ignored when you type it.

account.heading: Account
account.leadParagraph: Everything the service knows about your account, and what you can change.
account.emailImmutable: Moving an account to another address is not offered.
account.passwordSetLead: Your account has no password yet, because it was created through Google. Setting one lets you sign in without Google.
account.passwordChangeLead: Changing your password signs every device out.
account.passwordSuccess: Your password was set. Every device has been signed out.
account.dangerLead: This deletes your account and every link, group and workspace it owns. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmPrompt: Deleting is permanent. Confirm to continue.
